messages:
Maria: Quick sync for weekly GPU runway. I pulled the region rollups after last night's traffic surge. Need eyes on EU and APAC clusters and a short mitigation plan for the eu-west egress issues.

Alex: Topline: total GPU-hours requested +18% WoW. eu-west peak window (18:00-22:00 UTC) spiked +38% — looks correlated with the marketing campaign. us-west/us-east steady.

Jin: Can you paste the cluster rollup numbers?

Alex: Rollup (5m avg):
- eu-west-1/inference-poolA: 92% GPU util, queue depth +26%
- eu-west-1/burst: 65% util, but high packet drops on node egress
- us-west-2/inference-main: 58% util
- ap-southeast-1/inference: 74% util

Maria: Packet drops explain the throttling. Any infra/network policy changes?

Lia: No config changes. Cloud provider reported brief BGP flaps in eu-west around 2026-03-15T19:12Z. Ops-bot recorded two short outage windows.

ops-bot: [alert] bgp-flap-detected eu-west-1 2026-03-15T19:12:34Z -> 2026-03-15T19:13:12Z

Sam: Proposal: shift some inference traffic from eu-west burst -> reserved capacity in us-west during campaign peak. Latency impact ~+20-30ms but keeps throughput.

Jin: Need cost delta. Quick calc: moving 100 GPU-hours/day from eu-west spot -> us-west reserved delta ~$12/GPU-hr -> ~$1,200/day for campaign peak. CFO signoff needed if recurring.

Alex: Also recommend enabling KV-prefix caching for high-repeat prompts — should reduce token generation ~15% for top 500 queries. I'll post the canary config.

Alex: Config snippet (canary 5%):
```
service: inference
route: /v1/chat
cache:
  type: kv
  namespaces: ["prompt-prefix-500"]
  ttl: 600
```

Lia: Can we do a 5% canary in eu-west first before promoting?

Maria: Plan: 1) Canary cache config at 5% tonight; 2) If stable, bump to 30% tomorrow morning; 3) Pre-provision 50 GPU-hours reserved in us-west for 18:00-22:00 UTC for next 3 days; 4) Monitor packet drops and enable internal cross-region routing fallback if egress errors persist.

Sam: I'll draft cost approval including token-savings estimate. Ping me when you have exact reserved-hour count.

Alex: Note: cluster health shows two older eu-west nodes with sustained memory churn ~90% — likely driver/kernel mismatch. Suggest cordon + replace after canary.

Lia: Scheduling drain for those nodes at 02:00 UTC tonight. Ops-bot will trigger and report.

ops-bot: [action] drain-start eu-west-1-node-23 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z

Maria: Action items: Alex — post exact reserved-hour count and cost estimate here. Jin — run synthetic latency after canary (script below) and report p50/p95. Lia — watch for further BGP alerts and packet-drop trends.

Jin: On it. Synthetic test script (1k requests, prints p50/p95):
```
for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://eu-west.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq -r '.latency'; done | awk '{a[NR]=$1} END{print "p50",a[int(NR*0.5)]; print "p95",a[int(NR*0.95)]}'
```

Maria: We'll reconvene on Friday 09:00 UTC to review post-campaign metrics. If anything spikes before then, @here escalate.

Sam: :thumbsup:

Alex: Will update numbers in ~30m.

Lia: ops-bot will post drain and BGP follow-ups.
